 Breeders’ Cup returns to Keeneland for fourth time in Lexington 
 The World Championship features 14 races and $34 million in purses and awards on Friday and Saturday 
 By WKYT News Staff Published : Oct. 30, 2026 at 4:57 AM EDT | Updated : 6 hours ago Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google LEXINGTON, Ky. (WKYT) - The Breeders’ Cup is back at Keeneland.
 2026 marks the fourth time that the “Super Bowl of Horse Racing” has taken place in Lexington.
 What is the Breeders’ Cup
 The Breeders’ Cup World Championship features 14 races with $34 million in purses and awards.
 Horses qualify for Breeders’ Cup races by either winning a Breeders’ Cup Challenge race, accruing enough points based on their performance in major races throughout the year or by being selected by a panel of judges. there are a maximum of 14 horses chosen for each Breeders’ Cup Championship race.
 Breeder’s Cup Schedule
 Friday’s races will feature five undercard races before the five championship races.
 Friday
 Race 1: The Lanark - 11:55 a.m. 
 Race 2: The Headley - 12:30 p.m. 
 Race 3: The Thoroughbred Aftercare Alliance Stakes - 1:05 p.m. 
 Race 4: The Bosque Bonita - 1:40 p.m. 
 Race 5: The Haggin - 2:15 p.m. 
 Opening Ceremonies
 Race 6: Breeders’ Cup Juvenile Turf Sprint - 2:55 p.m. 
 Race 7: Breeders’ Cup Juvenile Fillies - 3:35 p.m. 
 Race 8: John Deere Breeders’ Cup Juvenile Fillies Turf - 4:15 p.m. 
 Race 9: FanDuel Breeders’ Cup Juvenile - 4:55 p.m. 
 Race 10: Breeders’ Cup Juvenile Turf - 5:35 p.m. 
 Saturday’s races will feature three undercard races before the nine championship races.
 Saturday
 Race 1: The Keene Place -11:15 a.m. 
 Race 2: The Fall Harvest - 11:50 a.m. 
 Race 3: The Main Chance - 12:25 p.m. 
 Opening Ceremonies
 Race 4: Breeders’ Cup Filly & Mare Sprint - 1:10 p.m. 
 Race 5: Prevagen Breeders’ Cup Turf Sprint - 1:48 p.m. 
 Race 6: Breeders’ Cup Dirt Mile - 2:26 p.m. 
 Race 7: Maker’s Mark Breeders’ Cup Filly & Mare Turf - 3:04 p.m. 
 Race 8: Cygames Breeders’ Cup Sprint - 3:42 p.m. 
 Race 9: FanDuel Breeders’ Cup Mile - 4:20 p.m. 
 Race 10: Longines Breeders’ Cup Distaff - 4:58 p.m. 
 Race 11: Longines Breeders’ Cup Turf - 5:36 p.m. 
 Race 12: Longines Breeders’ Cup Classic - 6:16 p.m. 
 WKYT Coverage
 WKYT will be live from Keeneland beginning at 5 a.m. Friday with coverage from the track all day.
